basic_information.occupation_lifestyle: Accountant, works long hours at a desk, minimal physical activity, relies on convenience foods.
basic_information.family_social_context: Married with two teenage children; feels pressure to provide but struggles to find time for self-care.

background: Diagnosed with hypertension six months ago; has been advised to lose weight and increase activity.

main_issue.behavior_or_health_issue: Sedentary lifestyle and poor dietary habits contributing to hypertension.
main_issue.duration: Several years, exacerbated by work stress.
main_issue.frequency_or_severity: Consistently high blood pressure readings; eats fast food 4-5 times a week.
main_issue.current_situation: Aware of the health risks but finds it difficult to prioritize health over work and family demands.
main_issue.why_it_matters: Wants to be healthy enough to see his children grow up but feels overwhelmed by the lifestyle changes required.

motivation.desire_to_change: Moderate; recognizes the need for change but feels stuck.
reasons_for_change: Desire to live longer for his children
motivation.importance_of_change: High importance, but low confidence in ability to maintain changes.

reasons_against_change: Stress relief from current eating habits
conflicting_goals: Maintaining high work performance vs. dedicating time to exercise

what_did_not_work: Maintaining the gym routine during tax season

beliefs_and_concerns: Believes his health issues are inevitable due to his career
Worried that exercise will take away time from his family

social_environment.family_influence: Wife is supportive but also busy.
social_environment.friends_and_peers: Colleagues often order out for lunch.

goals: Walk for 30 minutes, 3 times a week
Reduce fast food intake to once a week
